m2_definition.definition: Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with complete lineage.

definition_review.scope: A scoped real experimental pack can qualify; national completion, official polygons or M3/M4 precision are not added to the existing target. Actual permitted source snapshots, reproducible conversion, exact rights and coverage, approved immutable artifacts and real AGID verification remain mandatory.
definition_review.geometry_rule: Keep absent geometry none. A derived surface needs independently permitted address membership and lineage. A postal search card, street, parcel or building location is not an official postal perimeter.
definition_review.address_building_rule: Do not turn postal search text into a civic identifier, exact building link or occupant/ownership evidence. Exact address/building display requires separate permitted authoritative relationships.

postal_probe.query_scope: One public street-name fragment, no addressee, customer, building number, private record or parcel query. Returned headings define the observed result grouping; regionTypeId=1 is not assumed to mean a geographical region.
postal_probe.anonymous_antiforgery_session: Use only the public form's ephemeral anti-forgery cookie and hidden token, never an account session or authentication header. Values and source rows are not logged, saved or committed. No security mechanism is bypassed.

terms_markers: Access to search and view services is free of charge
nsdi_probe.rights_interpretation: These exact resource-specific conditions are present, not missing. Address/street terms restrict sharing transformed/adapted/combined resources and commercial use. Building terms permit adaptations but restrict commercial use. Do not equate a licence label or generic CC link with full release approval. Pure technical format changes are not automatically adaptations under the CC legal text; the exact planned artifact still needs review against the owner's full conditions. No agreement, paid access or rights-bearing records are requested.
